triggerCases.prompt: Adversarially self-review the current pull request before I mark it ready. Do not change or publish anything.

outputCases.prompt: Perform an adversarial self-review of the current PR and do not make changes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent, read-only review that checks the PR description, commit scope, SHA-pinned source, and CI before reporting confirmed findings or no findings.
assertions: The review captures the title and description, base/head revisions, and base-to-head commit history before judging scope or completeness.
The review accepts the supplied complete immutable snapshot as its evidence route and does not attempt remote lookup.
The review pins both boundaries, inspects the merge-base diff and every changed file, and can obtain needed review state when the CLI cannot provide it.
The independent pass applies the mandatory review-simplicity baseline even though the prompt does not request simplification.
The review stops and reports the missing capability when required state cannot be verified.
The review does not edit source, commit, push, or change the pull request.

outputCases.prompt: Perform one adversarial self-review of my current pull request and do not change anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate stop that requests the canonical pull-request identity before any tool or repository discovery.
assertions: The workflow stops because the supplied capability facts explicitly record that the pull-request identity and every supported evidence route are unavailable, not merely because the prompt omits a URL.
It stops and requests the canonical pull-request identity plus a usable immutable, local, or authenticated evidence route.

It does not inspect the current directory, search for alternate clients or repository metadata, enumerate unrelated local files, try unauthenticated web clients, retry network routes, or launch an independent review.

outputCases.prompt: Perform one adversarial self-review of my current pull request and do not change anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded attempt to resolve the canonical pull request through the exact current checkout or one authenticated interface instead of stopping only because the prompt omits a URL.
assertions: The workflow does not treat the missing prompt URL as proof that pull-request identity is unavailable.
It attempts identity and snapshot resolution through only the exact current checkout or one authenticated supported pull-request read interface.
If those routes cannot return a complete snapshot, it stops without searching unrelated files or metadata, trying alternate clients or unauthenticated web access, or launching the review.

outputCases.prompt: Self-review this pull request and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent read-only self-review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the self-review directly in chat.
The workflow and its internal simplicity pass do not create or open local review documents.
The workflow does not modify source or post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.

outputCases.prompt: Self-review my PR using this supplied snapshot and prepare the review document. Do not change code or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: One plain-language review that distinguishes new findings, earlier feedback still needing attention, and addressed concerns, with explicit actions and draft destinations.
assertions: The report separates a short overall assessment, previous-feedback status, and a numbered set of actions with clearly marked copy-pasteable text. It does not repeat each finding in the overview.
It checks all supplied discussion sources and retains the open false-value concern as needing a change despite the author claiming it was fixed.
It identifies the open trimming concern as fixed in code, without calling it an outstanding code defect, and distinguishes any reply still needed.
It retains the null-name problem despite the resolved flag and treats the locale concern as addressed despite its outdated location.
It accounts for the unanswered numeric-ID question in the review body and the explained, accepted decision about the default in the PR conversation.
It reports the new numeric-ID lookup failure separately from previous feedback, with src/normalize.js:3 as its location, and does not invent links or code locations.

It links follow-ups to the supplied original discussions and does not draft duplicate new comments for concerns already raised. Any suggested reply adds useful information and uses the correct user role.

Visible explanations state concrete effects and next steps in plain language, without dense technical shorthand or investigation narration. Necessary identifiers, uncertainty, and severity remain accurate.
It keeps optional proof outside suggested comments and distinguishes required changes from verification or discussion actions.
It does not modify code, post comments or reviews, resolve threads, or claim that the current PR has no outstanding feedback.
The independent agent completes its first pass without the earlier reviewers' conclusions; the parent reconciles previous feedback before delivery.

outputCases.prompt: Self-review this supplied PR snapshot in chat only. Do not change files or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A partial review with no duplicate new finding that still flags the known outstanding concern and missing discussion access.
assertions: It distinguishes no new findings from an outstanding previously raised false-value defect and retains that concern as a follow-up action.
It links discussion_r201 without inventing whether the thread is open or resolved, and does not draft a duplicate new finding.
It explicitly identifies unavailable review bodies, remaining threads, and PR conversation comments as a coverage limit instead of claiming all previous feedback was checked or addressed.
It uses the supplied code to assess the accessible concern without trying unavailable evidence routes or treating missing discussion as no comments.
It returns one concise report in chat with the assessment, prior-feedback status, and actions distinct, without writing files or posting to GitHub.
